Chang Assistant Professor of Business Administration Assistant Professor of Business Administration Edward Chang (he/him/his) is an Assistant Professor of Business Administration in the Negotiation, Organizations & Markets Unit at Harvard Business School. He teaches Inclusion in the MBA required curriculum and Negotiations in the MBA elective curriculum. Professor Chang studies diversity, equity, and inclusion in organizations.
